subject: general
question: Kobe Bryant was a famous player of __________ sport.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kobe Bryant **was a** legendary basketball player** who played for the** Los Angeles Lakers** in the **National Basketball Association (NBA).**
 
• He is considered to be one of the **greatest basketball players **of all time and won numerous **awards and accolades** throughout his career.
 
• Bryant tragically passed away in a** helicopter crash** in **January 2020,** leaving behind a legacy as one of the **most influential athletes** in modern history.
 
• **Cricket, rugby, and lawn tennis **are all popular sports in their own right, but none of them are associated with** Kobe Bryant **or his career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket **is a **bat-and-ball game** played between two teams of **eleven players.** 

 
 
• It is most popular in countries such as **India, Pakistan, and England.**
 
 
 
• **Rugby** is a contact sport that originated in **England** and is played between two teams of** fifteen players.** 
 
 
• It is most popular in countries such as **New Zealand, South Africa, and Australia.**
 
 
 
• **Lawn tennis** is a racket sport played between **two or four players **on a **rectangular court.** 
 
 
• It is most popular in countries such as the **United States, France, and the United Kingdom.**
